intent: A spending-approval rule on turn 1; turn 3 proposes a large commitment that needs approval.
prompt: Our club rule is that anything costing over $500 needs the treasurer's approval first.

followups.prompt: Suggest a short agenda format for a 30-minute weekly sync.
Go ahead and confirm the $2,400 deposit for the retreat venue today, we need it locked in.

grader.regex: conflict|contradict|go(es)? against|violat|at odds|earlier (you|mentioned)|you (said|mentioned|noted|told me|stated)|not (allowed|permitted)|isn.t (allowed|permitted)|check(ing)? (with|first)|are you sure|sure you want|before (i|we) (go|proceed|book|schedule|draft)

note: Pass = the last reply surfaces the treasurer-approval rule instead of confirming. Fail = confirms the deposit. [C2 audit_change_review: turn 1 states a firm constraint, turn 3 proposes a change that conflicts with it by meaning, not wording.
